rationale: P0 is a clean pair on declared-zero q4, so a temporary AND computes it directly (4 T, with a 0-T measurement uncompute). The unpaired middle T1 targets data qubit q3, so it uses a Jones 4-T Toffoli with one fresh ancilla. That gives 8 T total, which equals the relaxed floor (4 per pair + 4 per unpaired Toffoli).
